.]] Lightwood is a type of lumber native to Quel'Thalas. As part of the Lightbloom growing through Eversong Woods, its Light-based enchantment was observed in the wake of the battle for Quel'Danas, after the Sunwell was purified with M'uru's heart. It is coveted by both the blood elves, who have come to regard it as a valuable resource, and the forest trolls of Zul'Aman, who seek to use it against the Void. Cut lightwood feels comfortably warm to the touch and seems to emit the faintest glow from the inside grain.

Lindormi's Guidance is a level 2 affix for Mythic+, and remains until level 5. It highlights select non‑boss enemies with "Temporal Sands", reducing their health and damage by 5%. Defeating these marked enemies contributes 100% of the required enemy forces, providing a predetermined baseline route through the dungeon. Additionally, player deaths do not reduce the dungeon timer. This affix is designed to help players learn consistent routes during the early stages of a season and to make group coordination easier at lower keystone levels. These routes are not intended to be optimal for high‑end play, but instead serve as an introductory framework for players progressing into Mythic+. Lindormi

The Loa Speakers are an order of trolls chosen by the loa to be their voice among troll villages, tribes, and empires. They spread the wisdom and teachings of the loa to other loa worshipers, be they troll or not. Teaching others how to maintain altars, bring sacrifices and offerings to the loa, and how to perform other traditions and rituals of the loa they speak for, while themselves being responsible for performing the most important rites. )]] Lockout is a game system that prevent the repeated clearing of instances over and over to repeatedly farm bosses in a short period of time. Lockouts were initially only for raids (and are often still called "raid lockouts"), but the system was extended to Heroic and Mythic dungeons, and world bosses. Raids, world bosses, and Mythic Dungeons have weekly lockouts. Heroic dungeons have daily lockouts. Heroic dungeons queued through the dungeon Finder, Mythic+ keystones, and normal dungeons have no lockout. Loa Speaker Kinduru was a forest troll, a son of Zul'jin, and a speaker of the chief loa of the Amani tribe, Akil'zon. For that, he was one of the closest advisors to his sister-in-law Zarama and later his niece Zul'jarra. At his advice, Zul'jarra underwent the trials to become a hash'ey, reuniting the Amani with their loa. When his nephew, Zul'jan, learned of an ancient Amani weapon called Ula'tek, Kinduru helped him investigate. As their search led them down the same path as Hex Lord Malacrass, Kinduru repeatedly urged Zul'jan to stop, but his nephew dismissed his warnings, ultimately culminating in the loa speaker's death.
